Definition: properly, violent; by implication, a robber
BiblicalUsage: Chamowts appears once, in Isaiah's call to learn to do well: seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single verse is enough: God names the oppressor only to tell His people to stand against him.
